definitions.gloss: endangered species; species at risk of extinction
definitions.explanation: A species in danger of dying out. A shortened form of {絶滅危惧種|ぜつめつきぐしゅ}, used in conservation and news contexts to refer to plants and animals threatened with extinction.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{危惧種|きぐしゅ}だ。
examples.english: This bird is an endangered species.

examples.japanese: {危惧種|きぐしゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保護|ほご}する→保護する：25374_hogosuru⟧。
examples.english: We protect animals designated as endangered species.

examples.japanese: ⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生|い}き{物|もの}→生き物：01783_ikimono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{危惧種|きぐしゅ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: As a result of advancing development, many creatures have become endangered species.

notes:
A short form of ⟦{絶滅危惧種|ぜつめつきぐしゅ}→絶滅危惧種：04642_zetsumetsukigushu⟧ (literally 'feared-to-go-extinct species'). Made of ⟦{危惧|きぐ}→危惧：11862_kigu⟧ (fear, apprehension) + ⟦{種|しゅ}→種：28584_shu⟧ (species).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {危惧種|きぐしゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: designate as an endangered species
- {危惧種|きぐしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保護|ほご}する→保護する：25374_hogosuru⟧: protect an endangered species

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{希少種|きしょうしゅ}→希少種：28286_kishoushu⟧: rare species — small in number but not necessarily facing extinction.
- {絶滅種|ぜつめつしゅ}: extinct species — already died out.
